verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents an API endpoint that creates cards, including instant-issue virtual cards ready for immediate use, and offers a public sandbox. However, creating a card is not one call: you must first create a user and a card product. Nothing in the pack shows PAN, CVV, or expiry being returned programmatically at issuance, and sandbox cards cannot transact in the real world, with no documented self-serve path to production. Missing for 10: single-call issuance, documented programmatic PAN/CVV/expiry retrieval, evidence of a self-serve sandbox-to-live path without a sales cycle, and hands-on corroboration.
